questions.question: Q: Explain two reasons why the incarnation is important for Christians.

points.text: 1) The incarnation enables salvation — because Jesus is both fully God and fully human, he can bridge the gap between a holy God and sinful humanity. His divine nature gives his sacrifice infinite worth; his human nature means he can represent humanity. 2) The incarnation reveals God's nature — through Jesus' life and teachings, Christians can understand what God is like. questions.question: Q: "Jesus was just a good teacher, not the Son of God." Evaluate this statement.

points.text: Some people argue Jesus was merely a moral teacher because his teachings about love, forgiveness and justice are valuable regardless of his divine status.
